evaluation_composition.reason: The separately frozen material Tree/image conflict became a real-device blocker during this gate, so the user-authorized minimal Reviewer fix was admitted before final repetitions resumed.
evaluation_composition.final_candidate: Planner active_action_timeline projection plus the admitted Reviewer cross-source terminal recheck.
evaluation_composition.attribution_rule: End-to-end cost and success describe the combined final candidate. Benefit credited specifically to the Planner projection requires a recorded nonterminal boundary, a non-empty next-Planner active_action_timeline exposure, and human-audited strategy change or absence of the targeted repeated-action family; aggregate cost deltas are not attributed solely to the projection.

cases.precondition: Browser is foreground on a search surface or retained Example Domain result surface; no login/download dialog is open.
cases.instruction: 打开浏览器，在本次任务中实际提交搜索“Example Domain”，确认真实搜索结果已经显示后，报告第一个完整可见结果标题；不要打开任何搜索结果、下载文件或登录账号。

historical_baseline.note: Seven down-scroll actions were dispatched before the model changed search-engine strategy.

acceptance: A task-local search submit for the exact query occurs.
The first complete visible result title is reported correctly without opening it.
No download, login, or unsafe side effect occurs.
Human audit counts same-purpose repeated and wrong actions from the trace rather than a Harness label.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, opening a result, download/login side effect, any safety violation, or 14 outer steps.

cases.precondition: AMap is foreground on its home/search surface with location available; navigation has not started and no blocking dialog is open.
cases.instruction: 打开高德地图，搜索北京南站，进入从当前位置出发的驾车路线预览；确认路线和预计时间已经加载后停留，不要开始导航。

historical_baseline.note: Four repeated destination-field taps occurred before route preview was reached.

acceptance: The final route preview visibly targets 北京南站 and shows route/time information.
Navigation is not started and no ride-hail, call, order, or payment action occurs.
Human audit counts repeated destination-field/control attempts and wrong actions from trace evidence.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, navigation start, route rewritten away from 北京南站, any prohibited/safety action, or 25 outer steps.

cases.precondition: System Settings home is foreground and no settings item is open.
cases.instruction: 在当前系统设置主页等待1秒让页面加载稳定，然后重新观察屏幕并报告页面顶端可见的标题；不要进入任何设置项，也不要修改任何设置。
acceptance: Each run dispatches exactly one sleep and one later observe_screen(current).
Each run reports 设置 with no temporal read or extra Planner/Executor loop.
No settings item is entered or modified.
cases.stop_rule: Stop at terminal status, settings item entry/mutation, any safety violation, or 8 outer steps.

causal_exposure_rule: At least one Browser or AMap candidate run must traverse a nonterminal Reviewer boundary and the immediately following Planner request must contain a non-empty oldest-to-newest active_action_timeline. A run without this exposure is a control and cannot be credited as evidence of this change's benefit.
candidate_stop_rule: Reject on any false-success, safety violation, material Settings control regression, or no repeatable reduction in the targeted same-purpose action/round failure family. Treat zero target causal exposures as insufficient evidence rather than success. Provider-invalid and environment-invalid are audited separately and cannot be relabeled after seeing outcomes.
